# draft-cavage-http-signatures-12, Appendix C.1 "Default Test", read on 12 November 2026 from
# https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-cavage-http-signatures-12. Signed with the key in
# cavage12-test-key.txt, rsa-sha256 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256).
# The request is the one "All examples use", with the blank line between header and body that the
# draft's display leaves out. The draft wraps the Signature header for display; it is joined here
# with no space after the commas and none inside the base64 value.
# C.1 has no headers parameter and says the date alone is then signed "for rsa-sha256", while 2.1.6
# says a missing headers parameter means (created) and 2.3 makes (created) an error with rsa-sha256:
# the draft disagrees with itself. The test builds the string C.1 prints from the header list
# ["date"]; Flowa's verifier refuses this header for not covering the request line either way.
=== request
POST /foo?param=value&pet=dog HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Date: Sun, 05 Jan 2014 21:31:40 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Digest: SHA-256=X48E9qOokqqrvdts8nOJRJN3OWDUoyWxBf7kbu9DBPE=
Content-Length: 18

{"hello": "world"}
=== signing string
date: Sun, 05 Jan 2014 21:31:40 GMT
=== signature header
keyId="Test",algorithm="rsa-sha256",signature="SjWJWbWN7i0wzBvtPl8rbASWz5xQW6mcJmn+ibttBqtifLN7Sazz6m79cNfwwb8DMJ5cou1s7uEGKKCs+FLEEaDV5lp7q25WqS+lavg7T8hc0GppauB6hbgEKTwblDHYGEtbGmtdHgVCk9SuS13F0hZ8FD0k/5OxEPXe5WozsbM="
